hook: Tie your rats into one tangled Knot that shares every hit, then grow it as a council each turn.
loop: Place units next to each other to Tie them into a Knot.
End of Turn buffs and Gossip grow the whole Knot together.
The Knot splits every hit in fights, or unties for a volley.

growth.line: From Tier 4, End of Turn buffs hit every Knot unit; a full Knot of seven grows fastest.

feel.early: Strays and small buffs; little splitting yet
feel.mid: Bell-Ringer votes, Gossip skims, the Knot grows together
feel.late: Pick an ending: shared Health pool, the King, or Piper

stars.why: Whole board fights as one body with one Health pool
Unties the Knot for a free opening attack from everyone
Every share of a split hit gives that unit Attack

card_short.u01: Gains Attack per Knot-mate in fight; doubled beside a gap
card_short.u02: When played, summons a Stray next to it.
card_short.u03: Each turn one shop unit is cheaper and comes Tied.
card_short.u04: When played, Ties a neighbour and gives it permanent stats.
card_short.u05: End of Turn: buffs its Knot's two lowest-Health units.
card_short.u06: Gossip: skims a quarter of its Knot's gains each turn.
card_short.u07: End of Turn: +3/+3 to its Knot's biggest unit.
card_short.u08: Gains Attack for the fight each time it takes damage.
card_short.u09: When it dies, summons two Strays to patch the Knot.
card_short.u10: Quorum 5: Knot votes; everyone gains Attack or Health permanently.
card_short.u11: Start of Combat: Knot units copy their neighbours' keywords.
card_short.u12: Start of Combat: Ties the enemy across and its neighbours.
card_short.u13: Start of Combat: pokes its Knot and Tied enemies twice.
card_short.u14: Gossip, and doubles every Gossip in her Knot.
card_short.u15: Every Knot unit gains Attack whenever it takes damage.
card_short.u16: Can't attack. Buffs Knot each turn; Quorum 7 triples it.
card_short.u17: Quorum 6: Knot gets stats and one shared Health pool.
card_short.u18: Start of Combat: takes the stats of its whole Knot.
card_short.u19: Not Tied. Unties everyone; your largest Knot attacks at once.
card_short.x01: A 1/1 Tied Rat that fills Knot slots.

builds.name: Full Council
builds.line: Fill all seven slots; Bell-Ringer and Speaker grow everyone, Thirty-Two ends it.

builds.name: Gossip Mill
builds.line: Gossip rats skim a buffed carry's gains, and tied Oozes' meals.

builds.name: Knot by day, loose by night
builds.line: Grow tied, then the Piper unties for a free opening volley.

liked: Split damage rewrites Shield, Damage Reduction and every takes-damage trigger; no tribe does this.
The Piper: grow tied, fight untied, with a reading-order puzzle.
worries: Thirty-Two with Old Gundel: units can't die while their Attack keeps climbing.
Watch golden Ilse and Sniffer, Speaker at Quorum 7, golden King: may run away.
changed: Clearer split rule: hit unit takes the leftover; a 0 share isn't damage.
Bell-Ringer now holds a vote: +2 Attack or +2 Health for everyone.
Fips doubles beside an empty slot; Sweep also pokes Tied enemies.
verdict: Rated fun 7, distinct 8, reviewers call it done; ranked third of three Rat King designs, for players who like fight puzzles.
